writing.title: Part I Writing
writing.directions: Write an essay about how you organize your study time.
writing.prompt: Write an essay about how you organize your study time. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
writing.reference_answer: A sample essay about planning study time, taking short breaks, and reviewing progress.

questions.question: What does the speaker suggest about short study breaks?
options: They are only useful at night.
questions.explanation: 短休可以恢复注意力，因此 B 正确。

questions.question: Why does the speaker mention a weekly review?
questions.explanation: 每周复盘用于调整计划。

passages.title: Section A
passages.directions: Choose the best word for each blank.
passages.material: A regular study routine helps learners ___26___ their progress and build confidence. Keeping a simple record of what has been completed also makes it easier to ___27___ the next step.

questions.question: Choose the best word for blank 26.
questions.explanation: track progress 表示记录进展。

questions.question: Choose the best word for blank 27.
questions.explanation: plan the next step 表示规划下一步。

passages.title: Passage One
passages.directions: Read the passage and answer the questions.
passages.material: Many students believe that studying longer always leads to better results. Research on learning suggests a different picture. Short, focused sessions with clear goals are often more effective than long sessions without a plan. A brief review after each session also helps learners remember what they have studied.

questions.question: What does the passage say about long study sessions?
options: They are always the best choice.
They are not necessarily more effective.
questions.explanation: 文章指出长时间学习不一定更有效。

questions.question: What helps learners remember what they studied?
options: A brief review after each session.
questions.explanation: 短文提到简短复习有助于记忆。

translation.title: Part IV Translation
translation.prompt: 良好的学习习惯需要长期坚持。制定清晰的计划、定期复习，并在遇到困难时主动寻求帮助，都是提高学习效率的重要方法。
translation.reference_answer: Good study habits require consistent effort. Making a clear plan, reviewing regularly, and asking for help when facing difficulties are all important ways to improve learning efficiency.
